blocks.text: Condo buildings in Hyde Park South Surrey

This is a named-complex page, not an area page: Hyde Park is one townhome community by Zenterra Developments near 28 Avenue and 156 Street in Grandview Heights, South Surrey, and Hyde Park Corner is a separate, smaller townhome phase on the same street. Hyde Park has no board sub-area and no SnapStats row of its own.
Streets, schools and getting around Hyde Park South Surrey

items.t: The complex ground: Hyde Park sits near 28 Avenue and 156 Street in Grandview Surrey, north of Morgan Crossing, with Grandview Corners shopping about 1 km away (site copy). The page gives no civic address number for the main complex; MLS listing data for the complex uses 2888 156 Street and 15677 28 Avenue addresses, and Hyde Park Corner is at 2828 156 Street.

Board geography: there is no Hyde Park board sub-area and no Hyde Park row in the SnapStats data at all. The complex sits on Grandview ground in the Fraser Valley board community "S Surrey White Rock", so the Grandview sub-area row is the board context for this page's ground — it is not a Hyde Park figure. Any Hyde Park-specific inventory, solds, sales ratio, median or days-on-market figure is not verified.

blocks.text: Good to know about Hyde Park South Surrey

items.t: Two complexes share one street and one name — and different stratas. Hyde Park (156 townhomes per the developer brochure; strata plan EPS2381 per the page, not confirmed) and Hyde Park Corner (2828 156 Street, 2021) are separate stratas, so two listings on 156 Street can sit in different complexes with different fees and documents. The page gives the main complex no civic address at all — "near 28 Avenue and 156 Street" — while MLS data puts its units at 2888 156 Street and 15677 28 Avenue. Establish the strata plan from the listing's legal description before anything else.
The 156 count is the one figure the developer itself backs.

Floor-plan type is the real comparison inside this complex. The page states the complex was built with tandem-garage, double-garage and main-floor primary bedroom layouts (site copy), so two Hyde Park listings can be very different homes at similar prices — compare plan to plan, not just price to price.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Hyde Park

items.t: OCP — Surrey: Surrey's current Official Community Plan is Bylaw No. 21900, adopted June 15, 2026 — Bylaw 18020 is never cited as current. The ground's plan layer also includes the North Grandview Heights NCP for the neighbourhoods north of 28 Avenue from King George Boulevard to Highway 15.
Zoning — Surrey: Surrey Zoning Bylaw No. 12000 governs this ground.

SSMUH — Surrey, as the City states it: up to 3 units on lots under 280 m², up to 4 units on lots over 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots within 400 m of a frequent bus stop, under the SSMUH zones in Zoning Bylaw No. 12000. Eligibility is parcel-specific; no SSMUH claim is made for the Hyde Park strata lots themselves, whose form is fixed by their strata plans.

Strata block (the tenure that governs both counted complexes, and any bare-land strata lot): Form B within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page; depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws void since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss.123.1/123.2 + May 1, 2023 exemptions). A "45+" listing line is not a valid BC age bylaw.

blocks.text: Good to know about Hyde Park

items.t: Hyde Park (strata plan EPS2381, per the page — itself a queued, live-page-only figure) and Hyde Park Corner at 2828 156 Street are separate stratas, so fees, bylaws, depreciation reports and minutes differ between them even at the same street address pattern.
The 156 count is the one figure with a developer source behind it.

Grandview's attached pool is the second-largest in the community (Sep 2026). Grandview's 146 Condos & Townhomes listings sit behind only White Rock's 193 in S Surrey White Rock — Hyde Park resales are a single-complex subset of that pool, not a board category. (SnapStats FVR September 2026 report

Surrey taxes carry two penalty dates, not one. Due July 2, 5% if not paid by midnight July 2 and a further 5% after September 2 — a late lot or home purchase closing around those dates needs the tax position checked on the City account.
